title: Chips shelf (MuJoCo)
description: Gripper 7's robot shop assistant at a real supermarket's chips and nuts shelf, modelled from photos: two bays with 715 packages (Pringles, Lay's and Doritos tins, crisps tubes, gwoon nut tubs) each a body of its own with its printed front; the front row's 34 bags of chips and nuts deformable.
